post.caption: Turn this gem and its color changes. It is iolite, the gem variety of the mineral cordierite, and the name comes from a Greek word for violet. The color change is called pleochroism, and iolite shows it strongly, so cutters must orient the rough carefully to show its best color. It measures 7 to 7.5 on the Mohs scale, and stones from Sri Lanka's gem gravels have been called water sapphires. A Norse saga says a sunstone found the hidden sun. Some think it was a polarizing crystal, such as iolite or calcite, but no Viking sunstone has been found, so it remains a hypothesis.
